# Hotel Sitara Residency
> Premium boutique hotel accommodation located in Kalamboli, Navi Mumbai / Panvel, Maharashtra, India. Tailored for corporate executives, business travelers, families, and couples.

## About
Hotel Sitara Residency is a premier hospitality destination in Kalamboli, Navi Mumbai. Located close to the Mumbai-Pune Expressway, Sion-Panvel Highway, Kalamboli Steel Market, JNPT Port, and the Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA). The property features contemporary executive rooms, executive triple rooms, and family suites equipped with air conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, 24-hour room service, and secure on-site parking.

## Accommodations (Rooms & Suites)

### 1. Executive Room
- Slug: /bedrooms/executive-room
- Room ID: 8857
- Ideal For: Solo corporate travelers, business visitors, couples
- Occupancy: 1 to 2 Adults
- Key Features: Premium king or queen bed, individually controlled air conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen TV with satellite channels, modern ensuite bathroom with 24/7 hot water geyser, dedicated work desk, daily housekeeping, and 24-hour room service.

### 2. Executive Triple Room
- Slug: /bedrooms/executive-triple-room
- Room ID: 8858
- Ideal For: Traveling colleagues, small groups, families of 3
- Occupancy: Up to 3 Adults
- Key Features: Three comfortable single/twin beds with fresh linens, individual climate control, complimentary Wi-Fi, television entertainment, private bathroom with toiletries, workstation, and 24-hour room service.

### 3. Executive Family Suite
- Slug: /bedrooms/executive-family-suite
- Room ID: 8859
- Ideal For: Families, executive delegations, extended stays
- Occupancy: 2 to 6 Guests
- Key Features: Expansive multi-bed configuration (two double beds plus lounge seating), sitting lounge with sofa, coffee area, dual air conditioning units, high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen TV, spacious wardrobe, continuous hot water geyser, and 24-hour concierge service.

## Property Facilities & Amenities
- Complimentary High-Speed Wi-Fi across the property
- 24-Hour Front Desk and Concierge

- Geyser for 24-Hour Hot & Cold Water
- Flat-Screen TV in every room
